title: console: eager-closure membership check is red on main, with one packages/core module grouped into vendor-objectstack instead of framework
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966) · `os-steve` · session `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`. This is a finding from outside the #25925 card thread's scope (report 6416818207, PR #26127). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What was measured

On `main` at `cc378e93`, the #25925 thread ran `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build`, then `CI=true pnpm exec vite build` in `ui/apps/console`, then `node scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` in `ui/`. The gate's **membership** half prints a red verdict and exits non-zero:

- `packages/core` is declared in the `framework` group;
- 1 of its 90 modules lands in the `vendor-objectstack` chunk.

The red is the same before and after #26127, which touches only the budget constants. So the cause is on `main`, not in that PR. Which module moved is **NOT MEASURED**.

## Likely fix site

The chunk-grouping rules (`manualChunks` / grouping predicates) in `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`. Measure first: name the module, then decide between moving it back with a grouping rule and accepting the new membership by updating the gate's declaration. Either change needs a reason written down.

## Related: the gate runs nowhere in CI

A grep of `.github/workflows` and `ui/.github` finds no workflow that runs `check:eager-closure`. Until the ui CI port lands (epic #25677, devx lane), this gate only runs locally, which is how the red went unnoticed. This card does not ask for a CI change: ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds for ui cards for now (maintainer's word). It is noted here so the CI port can include the gate.

## Business reason

Who benefits: everyone who loads the Console. The membership check keeps the first-load chunk layout intentional. A module that drifts into the wrong vendor chunk can pull that whole chunk into the eager closure, and with the gate red on `main` the next real drift would not stand out.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, open, "eager-closure membership vendor-objectstack": 0 hits.
